name: WarGrowlmon
main_effect:
[Trash] [Main] If you have 4 or fewer cards in your hand, play this card with the play cost reduced by 2.
[On Play] [When Digivolving] Delete 1 of your opponent's level 4 or lower Digimon.
source_effect: [On Deletion] You may play 1 level 4 or lower [Dark Dragon] or [Evil Dragon] Digimon card from your trash without paying the cost.
